summary: The item 3 FuncBufType cast is cleared: comb_Write8(&g_comb_send_buf) is now a plain, truthful call that matches the target's $a0 setup. The body still reads the s32 pad words D_800A36C0 / D_800A36D0 through the unlabelled s16 alias symbols D_800A36C2 / D_800A36D2 (include/bb2.h:301,307), so it fails item 4, and item 3 for the missing label.

evidence.explanation: D_800A36C0 and D_800A36D0 are already typed externs (s32, src/main/28708.c:13,1748). The same body reads their low halves via (u16)D_800A36C0 and word-wide via lw/sw. D_800A36C2 / D_800A36D2 are second symbols for bytes inside those words (symbol_addrs.txt:1018 even says '+2 from D_800A36C0'). That is an alias symbol for an existing object. No Q98/Q99 or other per-function admission covers comb_ExchangePad: grep finds nothing in .claude/rules or docs/grind.

evidence.construct: the extern s16 D_800A36C2 / D_800A36D2 declarations carry no FAKE label (compare the labelled g_comb_send_buf_plus_0x4 at include/bb2.h:291-294)
evidence.explanation: As written, the declarations claim two independent halfword objects exist at 0x800A36C2 / 0x800A36D2, which is a false object model. The worker's measurements (unions and halves arrays score 4-7) do suggest the alias is what forces the target's lui/lh non-gp access. But in that case it is a codegen-shaping construct and needs /* FAKE: <measured reason> */ at the declaration. The var_8 FAKE comment's mention of the D_800A36C2 loads does not label the alias itself.

next_action: Either (a) find a single-object spelling of D_800A36C0 / D_800A36D0 that keeps the hi-half reads non-gp (lui/lh) while the word and lo-half reads stay gp-relative, or (b) take the worker's open question to the owner as a needs-user-downgrade entry: may comb_ExchangePad keep the FAKE-labelled s16 alias symbols D_800A36C2 / D_800A36D2 for the high halves of the s32 pad words? Measured: the target reads the hi halves as lui/lh symbol+2 but the lo halves and words gp-relative, and every union or halves-array model tried scores 4 or more. Until a Judge or owner admission lands, add the FAKE labels at include/bb2.h:301,307 regardless; that clears item 3 but not item 4.
